preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 500000.
Length of each sequence N is between 4 and 100000.
Each element a_i in the sequence is between -1000000000 and 1000000000.

postconditions.description: The output sequence b has the same length as the input sequence a.

postconditions.expression: all(b[i] - b[i-1] == d for i in range(1, N))
postconditions.description: The output sequence b is an arithmetic sequence with a common difference d.

postconditions.expression: sum(a[i] != b[i] for i in range(N)) <= 1
postconditions.description: The output sequence b differs from the input sequence a in at most one position.
